clue.text: Port, or what keeps it in the bottle?

definitions.text: what keeps it in the bottle

blocks.note: first meaning: a harbour city in the south of Ireland

blocks.clueFragment: what keeps it in the bottle
blocks.note: second meaning: the stopper pushed into a bottle's neck

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether to talk about the fortified wine or the stopper sealing it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like the drink, which the second half seems to continue, but the first definition is a harbour: the Irish city and county of the same name.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an Irish seaport and the bark plug that seals wine bottles.

clue.text: Hanging in part of prison - confess about it

indicators.note: 'about it' places one word around the other, as a fence goes about a field

blocks.note: to sing is criminal slang for informing or confessing to the police
a prison is divided into wings

explanation.surface: A prisoner facing the gallows in one block of the jail is urged to own up.
explanation.walkthrough: The grim surface suggests execution, but the definition means dangling or swaying, not the gallows.
explanation.definitionFit: Something hanging from a hook sways freely back and forth, which is what swinging describes.

clue.text: Chance of extra sales in racing town?

blocks.note: first meaning: a fresh outlet for selling goods
second meaning: the Suffolk town that is the home of British horse racing

explanation.surface: A business spots an opportunity to sell more in a town famous for horse racing.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words the answer is a business opportunity; as one word it is the Suffolk town, the headquarters of English flat racing.
explanation.definitionFit: A fresh market means more customers, and the town hosts famous racecourses and training stables.

clue.text: Harshly criticise a god

blocks.note: first meaning: to slate a play or film in a review
second meaning: the Greek goat-legged deity of shepherds

explanation.surface: Someone launches a blasphemous attack on a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Critics who savage a show are said to do this, and the Greek woodland deity bears the same name.

clue.text: Softly press to clear

blocks.note: p, piano, is the musical marking for playing softly
to press someone is to urge them

explanation.surface: Gentle pressure is applied to clear a blockage.
explanation.definitionFit: To purge is to rid or cleanse something of unwanted matter or people.

clue.text: My face is warm

blocks.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like 'my!'
dial is slang for the face

explanation.surface: Someone notices their own cheeks are flushed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My' reads as a possessive but is the exclamation, and dial is British slang for the face.
explanation.definitionFit: A cordial welcome is friendly and heartfelt, the same sense as a warm greeting.

clue.text: Chinese dish in First prepared by railway

indicators.note: food that is prepared has been worked over and rearranged, so the letters are reworked

blocks.note: the letters of this word rearranged
RY is the standard abbreviation for railway

explanation.surface: A Chinese meal is cooked first, perhaps in a station buffet.
explanation.definitionFit: A dish of small pieces fried fast in hot oil, a staple of Chinese cookery.

clue.text: Greek character holds her wrongly to be an Indian leader

indicators.note: something done wrongly is done out of order, so these letters are mixed up
to hold something is to have it inside you

blocks.note: nu is the thirteenth letter of the Greek alphabet
the word scrambled

explanation.surface: A Greek person mistakenly detains a woman, taking her for an Indian politician.
explanation.walkthrough: The Greek letter nu goes around a jumble of 'her'.
explanation.definitionFit: Jawaharlal Nehru was the first prime minister of independent India.

clue.text: Suffer slur on backward American

indicators.note: backward tells us to read the word from its end to its start
on means placed after, in a down or across sequence

blocks.note: US is short for American, as in the US
a slur on someone's name is a stain on their reputation

explanation.surface: Someone endures an insult about a slow-witted American.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backward' reads as an insult to the American, but it only turns US around.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain an injury or loss is to undergo or experience it.

clue.text: He may be third or twelfth man, but nothing in between

definitions.text: He may be third or twelfth man, but nothing in between

blocks.clueFragment: He may be third or twelfth man, but nothing in between
blocks.note: surface reading: a man allowed just two places in a numbered sequence, a puzzling arithmetic riddle
setter's reading: third man is a fielding position and the twelfth man is the reserve fielder in a team sport played with bat and ball

explanation.walkthrough: Third man is a fielding position near the boundary behind the wicketkeeper; the twelfth man is the team's substitute. There is no fourth to eleventh 'man' position, hence nothing in between.
explanation.definitionFit: Third man and twelfth man are roles taken by a player of the bat-and-ball game.

clue.text: It's good as fuel

blocks.note: G is the abbreviation for good
taken as written

explanation.surface: A recommendation that something is fine to burn as fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural gas or petrol (called gas in America) is burned to power stoves, cars and heating.

clue.text: Notice pressure creating leak slowly

blocks.note: to notice something is to see it
P is the symbol for pressure in physics

explanation.surface: A plumber spots that pressure in a pipe is causing a slow drip.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid that oozes gradually through small gaps or pores does exactly this.

clue.text: What's added to book needing an operation to remove it?

definitions.text: needing an operation to remove it

blocks.note: first meaning: supplementary material at the back of a volume

blocks.clueFragment: needing an operation to remove it
blocks.note: second meaning: the small organ off the gut taken out by surgeons when inflamed

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a single question about a book needing surgery; the two halves are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an extra section at the end of a text and the gut organ removed in an appendectomy.

clue.text: Journalist's work includes article "The Forest Treetops"

indicators.note: includes means one thing is taken inside another

blocks.note: copy is the text a journalist writes
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A reporter's piece contains a feature headlined about forest treetops.
explanation.walkthrough: The quotation marks make the definition look like a headline inside the article.
explanation.definitionFit: The uppermost layer of branches and leaves in woodland forms a roof over the forest floor.

clue.text: Offered money, tip till up

indicators.note: to tip something up is to turn it over
in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom

blocks.note: a till is the cash drawer of a shop register

explanation.surface: Someone is offered cash as a tip from the till.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tip' looks like a gratuity, but 'tip till up' means turn the till upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: A reward is a sum promised to anyone who returns lost property or catches a criminal.

clue.text: Wife fine to make 13 here

definitions.note: a place to cook the dish in 13: the pan used for it

blocks.note: W is the abbreviation for wife
OK means fine

explanation.surface: A wife is happy for the cooking to happen here.
explanation.walkthrough: 13 across is STIR-FRY, so the definition asks for the pan it is cooked in.
explanation.definitionFit: The deep round-bottomed Chinese pan is the usual vessel for quick frying over high heat.

clue.text: Mother, they say, has book showing animal sanctuary

blocks.note: Mother Nature is the common personification of the natural world
to book a table is to reserve it

explanation.surface: A mother is rumoured to own a book about animal sanctuaries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'They say' is not a sound-alike signal: it points to the saying Mother Nature.
explanation.definitionFit: A protected area of land kept for wildlife is a refuge where animals live undisturbed.

clue.text: Weaken one married couple

blocks.note: I is the Roman numeral one
M is the abbreviation for married
a couple is a pair

explanation.surface: A spouse undermines the bond within a married couple.
explanation.definitionFit: To impair hearing or judgment is to damage it and make it less effective.

clue.text: Moderate information let out

indicators.note: out here means wrong or disordered, so the letters before it are rearranged

blocks.note: gen is British slang for information
the word rearranged

explanation.surface: Restrained details are released to the public.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Let out' reads as releasing information, but only 'out' is the signal, acting on 'let'.
explanation.definitionFit: A mild breeze or slope is not severe, so gentle describes something of moderate degree.

clue.text: Overwhelmed with dread as weak crust collapses

indicators.note: something that collapses falls into a jumble, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: these nine letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A baker watches in horror as a feeble pastry case caves in.
explanation.definitionFit: Being filled with awe means being struck by wonder mixed with fear or reverence.

clue.text: Body of soldiers and police suppressing resistance

indicators.note: to suppress is to hold down and keep in, so one word sits inside the other

blocks.note: cops are police officers
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: Troops and police put down a resistance movement.
explanation.definitionFit: A military unit such as an army corps is an organised group of troops.

clue.text: Light bites, new in big bags

indicators.note: in means one thing is placed inside another

blocks.note: sacks are large bags
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: Fresh light refreshments are packed into large sacks.
explanation.definitionFit: Small quick meals or nibbles between proper meals are casually called light bites.

clue.text: Shed light around the last to enter venerated site

indicators.note: the last to enter picks out the final letter of that word
around means one thing surrounds another

blocks.note: to shine is to shed light
the final letter of this word

explanation.surface: Light is cast around the final pilgrim to come into a holy place.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrine is a holy place honoured because of its link with a saint or relic.

clue.text: Teased for being poorly dressed

blocks.note: first meaning: past tense of rag, to make fun of someone
second meaning: wearing torn, tattered clothes

explanation.surface: A child is mocked at school for wearing shabby clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: To rag someone is to mock them, and tattered clothes or their wearer are described as ragged.

clue.text: Sort of hairdresser seen in Tunis, exceptionally

indicators.note: seen in says the letters are visible inside the words that follow

blocks.note: the run of letters spanning the two words

explanation.surface: A notable salon is spotted in the Tunisian capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A hairdresser serving both men and women alike is described by this word.

clue.text: Untidy place yields useful information

blocks.note: first meaning: a messy room or rubbish dump
second meaning: a helpful hint

explanation.surface: Rummaging in a messy spot turns up something helpful.
explanation.walkthrough: A tip is British for a rubbish dump, and so for any very untidy room.
explanation.definitionFit: A messy room is called a dump, and a handy hint or piece of advice is a pointer.
